title: Millions of SUV, trucks have dangerous front blind zone
summary: A local TV news investigation showing that many SUVs and trucks have a large blind zone directly in front, hiding children from the driver. It includes a demonstration lining kids up in front of a vehicle.
why: HN cites it in threads about large vehicles and pedestrian safety as a vivid demonstration of front blind zones.

quote.text: it took 13 kids in a line for an SUV driver to spot them
